redistribution_review.default: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 for unmarked OCW objects, preserving MIT and original authors
redistribution_review.method: Full source text searched for contrary labels, courtesy/permission/third-party credits; all 386 substantial embedded bitmap objects viewed in 13 contacts, source page/credit context checked for third-party-looking plots/photos. Vector teaching diagrams covered by source review; no external commercial-book scans incorporated into Chinese book. This is a declared-object review, not a claim to have proved ownership of every image.
redistribution_review.mixed_assignment_handling: Retain all 13 full MIT questions. Keep 85 Kleppner & Kolenkow reference-only entries and MIT corrections; do not invent or reproduce unavailable book statements.
